scope: Q4 implementation and local synthetic verification; full mac24 summary and formal selection pending

review.head: be168bbc5fb9056c548a8557a3d37326040f10aa
review.fix: Add explicit Compose build jobs before verify so mac24 does not verify the stale Q3 image.
review.verification: Documented build then quality suite passed; documentation-only change, no new implementation test.
review.scope_limit: Unchanged Q1–Q3 prediction generation and private remote predictions were not reassessed.

decisions_and_limits.decision: Use a native isolated worktree and manual Q4 brief; run official demo from a clean clone with its own configuration.
decisions_and_limits.reason: Preserve main and private artifacts; approved plan uses Q4 headings rather than helper Task N headings; Colima mounts the original workspace.
decisions_and_limits.cost_if_wrong: Extra checkout/storage and manual tracking; clean commit checks and review guard source consistency.

decisions_and_limits.decision: Reject and redraw bootstrap replicas with an empty fold, reporting the count.
decisions_and_limits.reason: Equal-fold means are undefined for an empty resampled fold; only tiny fixtures are likely to encounter this.
decisions_and_limits.cost_if_wrong: Conditional bootstrap for very small/sparse fold populations; real-fold discarded count remains visible.

decisions_and_limits.decision: Tie cohort includes eligible candidates within 0.0001 of the maximum mean MAP, then cost, memory, stable G/RH/RG order.
decisions_and_limits.reason: Deterministic interpretation without transitive pairwise ties.
decisions_and_limits.cost_if_wrong: Alternative tie interpretation could select a different method; rule and tests are explicit.

decisions_and_limits.decision: Hash actual per-buyer metric bytes; bind ranking manifests/hashes to closed source reports without rereading ranking bytes.
decisions_and_limits.reason: Q4 uses metrics, while Q1–Q3 already checked predictions. Reports explicitly record ranking_bytes_rehashed=false.
decisions_and_limits.cost_if_wrong: Q4 would not detect later changes to unused ranking bytes; selection still uses hashed metrics.

decisions_and_limits.decision: Retain prior Q1–Q3 audits rather than reassess unchanged prediction generation in the final Q4 code review.
decisions_and_limits.reason: Q4 checks immutable ancestry, identities and metrics, not retraining or generating predictions.
decisions_and_limits.cost_if_wrong: An undetected bug in original prediction generation is outside this new review; source evidence and prior tests remain available.

fixture_issue_fixed: Compose /tmp is about 4 GiB, below the 5 GiB production disk floor; component tests mock disk capacity. Official detached demo uses real artifact disk and unchanged limits.

runs.preflight_failure: Synthetic fixture archives were in data-jobs, not handoff/incoming; no worker launched.

limits: Synthetic sources were component fixtures, not physical mac24 executions. Only the Q4 wrapper ran as an official detached job.
Source fixture ZIPs were copied byte-for-byte into handoff after the first preflight refusal; failed attempt was exported and published.
No H&M training, test evaluation, T4 service or formal full selection executed here.
External MLflow integration was skipped; tracking implementation was unchanged.
Final full Q4 requires private per-buyer metrics and twelve closed full reports retained in mac24.
